verdict.rationale: Flagsmith docs and GitHub README clearly document trait-based targeting ("target features to users with specific traits such as geography, subscription level, device type"), reusable segments defined by rules on traits, identity-level overrides, and percentage-based rollout rules within segments — directly matching the story of attribute-based rules and reusable segments for variation targeting. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of segment/targeting behavior beyond vendor docs.
